crew.overview: Armed with the astonishing ability to shrink in scale but increase in strength, master thief Scott Lang must embrace his inner-hero and help his mentor, Doctor Hank Pym, protect the secret behind his spectacular Ant-Man suit from a new generation of towering threats. Against seemingly insurmountable obstacles, Pym and Lang must plan and pull off a heist that will save the world.
crew.title: Ant-Man

crew.overview: A kindhearted street urchin named Aladdin embarks on a magical adventure after finding a lamp that releases a wisecracking genie while a power-hungry Grand Vizier vies for the same lamp that has the power to make their deepest wishes come true.
crew.title: Aladdin

crew.overview: When the creator of a popular video game system dies, a virtual contest is created to compete for his fortune.
crew.title: Ready Player One

crew.overview: Against the vibrant backdrop of a 1960s-inspired, retro-futuristic world, Marvel's First Family is forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, while defending Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic Herald, Silver Surfer.
crew.title: The Fantastic 4: First Steps

crew.overview: After his career is destroyed, a brilliant but arrogant surgeon gets a new lease on life when a sorcerer takes him under her wing and trains him to defend the world against evil.
crew.title: Doctor Strange

crew.overview: Light years from Earth, 26 years after being abducted, Peter Quill finds himself the prime target of a manhunt after discovering an orb wanted by Ronan the Accuser.
crew.title: Guardians of the Galaxy

details.biography:
Daniele Bigi is a visual effects supervisor at Industrial Light & Magic. He joined Industrial Light & Magic’s London studio in January 2015 as CG Supervisor on Marvel’s Ant-Man. His credits as CG Supervisor also include Guardians of the Galaxy and Doctor Strange, both at ILM. Daniele later served as Associate Visual Effects Supervisor on Steven Spielberg’s Ready Player One, for which he received a Visual Effects Society Award for Outstanding Virtual Cinematography in a Photoreal Project. He has since overseen the visual effects for Marvel’s Eternals and contributed to major titles such as Disney’s Aladdin and Lucasfilm’s Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker.

Originally from Lake Como, Italy, Daniele studied Industrial Design in Milan, where he began exploring 3D computer graphics as a tool for automotive design. A lifelong film enthusiast, he discovered a passion for visual effects as a way to merge his artistic sensibility with his technical skills. This led him to pursue a career in the VFX industry, beginning with smaller studios in Italy before moving on to Aardman Animations, where he joined the emerging 3D department. He then held roles at Framestore and MPC.
details.name: Daniele Bigi
